sloka: राजन् दास्यामि शबलाम् राशिभी रजतस्य वा ।न परित्यागम् अर्हा इयम् मत् सकाशात् अरिन्दम ॥१-५३-१२॥
transliteration: rājan dāsyāmi śabalām rāśibhī rajatasya vā ।na parityāgam arhā iyam mat sakāśāt arindama ॥1-53-12॥

translations.english: O Suppressor of enemies Viswamitra it is not proper to separate this cow from me. The relationship between Sabala and me is permanent like the relationship between a righteous man and his fame.
